task_title: readJSON rejects trailing JSON documents (400 after the first document)
task_criteria: 1) readJSON (internal/api/server.go:251) after json.Decode verifies the stream is exhausted via dec.Token(): io.EOF -> OK, any other value -> 400 with an invalid-JSON trailing-data error. Live repro on :8766 was a discover body ending in a second document ({..}{"junk":1}) returning 200. 2) A trailing-WHITESPACE body still decodes and returns 200 (Token returns io.EOF). 3) New tests in internal/api assert the trailing-document 400 and the trailing-whitespace 200; duplicate-key and unknown-field behavior unchanged. 4) go build ./... , go vet ./... and go test ./... -count=1 all pass. 5) ch:trace row=REVIEW-OB-022 marker present in a committed test artifact; committed tree greppable: grep -c 'ch:trace row=REVIEW-OB-022' internal/api/server_test.go >= 1 (create server_test.go in package api if it does not exist).
